name: @cernion/cet-ui
description: CET RC2 deterministic React/Vite/TypeScript SPA for Tagesfläche, Vorgangsansicht, Nachweisansicht and Operationskonsole.

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && node -c src/shared/ui-view-model.js && node -c src/shared/api-client.js && node -c src/shared/contract-validators.js && node -c src/shared/projection-helpers.js && node -c src/shared/role-tenant-helpers.js && node -c src/shared/wording-helpers.js && node -c src/shared/evidence-helpers.js && node -c src/shared/prominence-helpers.js && node -c src/shared/audit-hooks.js && node -c scripts/verify-static-app.js
